ProductPage.title: One QR. The complete story.
ProductPage.subtitle: Everything you need to track, prove, and share the maintenance history of any machine — nothing you don't.
ProductPage.feature1Sub: Stick it once. Every scan pulls up the complete, permanent history — no app to install.
ProductPage.feature2Sub: Every inspection, repair, and part change — logged with dates, notes, and who did the work.
ProductPage.feature3Sub: Services logged by verified Maintlers carry a Verified badge, building trust automatically.
ProductPage.feature4Sub: Anyone can scan and see the history instantly. Free, worldwide, no account needed.
ProductPage.feature5Sub: Registering and logging services is free. Verified professional status is optional, for extra credibility.
ProductPage.feature6Sub: Cars, generators, HVAC, boats, aircraft and more — one system for everything you maintain.
ProductPage.liveExampleTitle: This isn't a mockup. It's a real report.
ProductPage.liveExampleDesc: Open a live example — the same page anyone gets when they scan a real Maintly QR.

HowItWorksPage.title: From sticker to full history in seconds.
HowItWorksPage.subtitle: No training, no setup, no manuals. If you can scan a QR code, you already know how to use Maintly.
HowItWorksPage.step1Sub: Stick a tamper-proof Maintly QR on the machine. Takes seconds, lasts for the life of the equipment.
HowItWorksPage.step2Sub: No app, no login. Any phone camera opens the machine's full history instantly.
HowItWorksPage.step3Sub: Every past service — dates, parts, notes, who did the work — right there for anyone to see.
HowItWorksPage.step4Sub: Any logged-in Maintler adds new service records in seconds, building the permanent record.
HowItWorksPage.liveExampleTitle: Skip the sticker. See the result.
HowItWorksPage.liveExampleDesc: Open a live example report — exactly what a scan looks like on a real machine.

AboutPage.title: Every machine deserves a memory.
AboutPage.subtitle: MaintlyQR is a global, QR-based maintenance history for any machine — practical, simple, and built to last as long as the equipment does.
AboutPage.section1Sub: Maintenance history gets lost. It lives in notebooks, group chats, and someone's memory — and disappears the moment a machine changes hands or a mechanic moves on.
AboutPage.section2Sub: Give every machine a permanent, verifiable maintenance record — tied to the machine itself, accessible with a single scan, anywhere in the world. Every Maintler helps preserve the story of an asset.
AboutPage.section3Sub: Mechanics, electricians, HVAC technicians, fleet managers, inspectors, and every owner who wants proof of the work — anyone who maintains an asset is a Maintler.

CookiesPage.pageSubtitle: What cookies MaintlyQR uses and why — essential only, nothing more.
CookiesPage.s1P1: Cookies are small text files placed on your device by a website when you visit it. They are widely used to make websites work efficiently, provide functionality, and give site owners information about how their sites are used.
CookiesPage.s2P1: MaintlyQR uses essential cookies only. We do not use advertising cookies, tracking pixels, social media cookies, or third-party analytics cookies.
CookiesPage.s2P2: Our approach is minimal by design: we collect only what is necessary to operate the Platform and provide you with a secure, functional experience.
CookiesPage.tableRow2Purpose: Keeps you signed in across browser sessions (Supabase Auth)
CookiesPage.s3Note: These cookies are set by Supabase, our authentication provider. Without them, you cannot log in or remain signed in to the Platform.
CookiesPage.s4Bullet1: Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or any third-party tracking scripts
CookiesPage.s4Bullet3: Social media cookies or share buttons that track you
CookiesPage.s4Bullet5: Cookies that collect personal data beyond what is needed for authentication
CookiesPage.s5P1: Because we use only essential cookies, blocking or deleting them will prevent you from logging in to the Platform. You can manage cookies through your browser settings, but note that disabling essential cookies will break authentication.
CookiesPage.s5P2: If you access public QR pages without logging in, no cookies are required and none are set.
CookiesPage.s6P1Prefix: Our authentication cookies are managed by Supabase. Supabase's privacy policy is available at
CookiesPage.s6P1Suffix: We host the Platform via Vercel, which may set technical cookies for load balancing and performance purposes.

PrivacyPage.pageSubtitle: How MaintlyQR collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information.
PrivacyPage.s1P1: MaintlyQR™ ("MaintlyQR", "we", "us", "our") is a technology platform providing QR-based digital identity and maintenance history tracking for physical assets. MaintlyQR is operated pending formal legal incorporation; upon incorporation, the operating entity will be MaintlyQR Pty Ltd (ACN pending), headquartered in Queensland, Australia. References to "MaintlyQR" apply equally to any successor legal entity.
PrivacyPage.s1P2: This Privacy Policy explains how we handle personal information collected through www.maintlyqr.com (the Platform). We comply with the Australian Privacy Act 1988, the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), and where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and UK GDPR.
PrivacyPage.s2Bullet2: Professional details (mechanic or business name, trade registration number)
PrivacyPage.s2Bullet3: Asset information (type, make, model, serial number, location)
PrivacyPage.s2Bullet4: Maintenance and service records (dates, descriptions, mileage, hours, parts used)

PrivacyPage.s3Bullet4: Operate, maintain, and improve the Platform

PrivacyPage.s3Bullet8: In anonymised or aggregated form: improve AI features and analyse Platform usage
PrivacyPage.s3NoSale: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Ever.
PrivacyPage.s4P1: The maintenance records you add to any asset's Maintenance Ledger are publicly visible to anyone who scans the associated QR code — this is a core feature of MaintlyQR.
PrivacyPage.s4P2: By adding records, you acknowledge this information is publicly accessible. Do not include sensitive personal information in service records or asset descriptions.
PrivacyPage.s5Intro: We share your information only with:
PrivacyPage.s5Bullet1: Supabase — database, authentication, and storage provider (data encrypted in transit and at rest)
PrivacyPage.s5Bullet2: Vercel — hosting and content delivery provider
PrivacyPage.s5Bullet3: Legal and regulatory authorities, when required by law
PrivacyPage.s5P1: We do not use third-party advertising networks, tracking pixels, or data brokers. All providers are bound by their own privacy policies and are selected for their high security standards.
PrivacyPage.s6Intro: Your data is stored using Supabase, which provides:
PrivacyPage.s6Bullet3: Row-level security ensuring users can only access their own data
PrivacyPage.s6P1: We apply industry-standard security practices. No system is 100% secure. In the event of a data breach affecting your rights, we will notify you as required by applicable law.
PrivacyPage.s7P1: MaintlyQR may use AI to analyse patterns in anonymised, aggregated maintenance data to improve Platform features. Your personally identifiable information is not used to train external AI models. If AI features are applied directly to your records, you will be informed.
PrivacyPage.s8P1: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. Upon account deletion, we delete your personal information within 30 days, except where retention is legally required.

PrivacyPage.s9AuLine: Australian users: rights under the Privacy Act 1988 and Australian Privacy Principles.
PrivacyPage.s9EuLine: EU/UK users: rights under the GDPR/UK GDPR, including the right to lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority.
